output.reason: An 8-year-old with one-sided ear pain since last night, no fever, eating normally and attending school has no reported feature requiring urgent assessment, so supported OTC pain relief and observation with specific return triggers meet the current need without a remaining clinician task.
output.patientMessage: You can care for her at home for now: give an age- and weight-appropriate over-the-counter pain reliever per the label and watch her. Most short-lived ear pain in a well child settles on its own. Message us in this thread if the pain lasts beyond 2–3 days, or seek care today for fever, ear drainage, swelling or tenderness behind the ear, a pushed-out ear, drowsiness, stiff neck, or worsening pain.
